import React from "react"; import carImage from "./assets/car_image.jpg"; export default function ViewVehicleDetails({ vehicle, onBack, onLoginClick, onRegisterClick }) { const [showBookingNav, setShowBookingNav] = React.useState(false); const mainVehicle = vehicle || { name: "Hyundai i20", fuel: "Petrol", transmission: "Manual", seats: "5 Seater", priceHour:"₹149", priceDay: "₹1499", priceWeek: "₹8999", priceMonth: "₹29999", rating: "4.5", reviews: 126, distance: "1.2 km away", owner: { name: "Amit Sharma", rating: "4.7", reviews: 89, joined: "Jan 2022", phone: "+91 98765 43210", email: "amit.sharma@example.com", }, }; const imageSources = [ carImage, carImage, carImage, carImage, carImage, ]; const visibleThumbnails = imageSources.slice(0, 3); const [activeImageIndex, setActiveImageIndex] = React.useState(0); const [calendarDate, setCalendarDate] = React.useState(new Date()); const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = React.useState(null); const availableDates = new Set([16, 17, 18, 19, 20, 23]); const daysOfWeek = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat", "Sun"]; const monthName = calendarDate.toLocaleString("default", { month: "long" }); const year = calendarDate.getFullYear(); const monthIndex = calendarDate.getMonth(); const firstDayIndex = (new Date(year, monthIndex, 1).getDay() + 6) % 7; const daysInMonth = new Date(year, monthIndex + 1, 0).getDate(); const calendarCells = Array.from({ length: 42 }, (_, idx) => { const dayNumber = idx - firstDayIndex + 1; return dayNumber > 0 && dayNumber <= daysInMonth ? dayNumber : null; }); const handlePrevMonth = () => { setCalendarDate((prev) => new Date(prev.getFullYear(), prev.getMonth() - 1, 1)); setSelectedDate(null); }; const handleNextMonth = () => { setCalendarDate((prev) => new Date(prev.getFullYear(), prev.getMonth() + 1, 1)); setSelectedDate(null); }; const handleDateClick = (day) => { if (!day || !availableDates.has(day)) return; setSelectedDate(day); }; const features = [ { icon: "⛽", label: "Fuel Type", value: mainVehicle.fuel }, { icon: "⚡", label: "Mileage", value: "18 km/l" }, { icon: "⚙️", label: "Transmission", value: mainVehicle.transmission }, { icon: "👥", label: "Seating Capacity", value: mainVehicle.seats }, { icon: "🛠️", label: "Engine", value: "1197 cc" }, { icon: "💪", label: "Power", value: "82 bhp" }, { icon: "🧳", label: "Boot Space", value: "311 L" }, { icon: "❄️", label: "Air Conditioner", value: "Yes" }, { icon: "🔊", label: "Bluetooth", value: "Yes" }, { icon: "🔌", label: "USB Charger", value: "Yes" }, { icon: "🎵", label: "Music System", value: "Yes" }, ]; const ownerPolicies = [ { icon: "🚭", title: "Smoking", subtitle: "Not Allowed" }, { icon: "🐾", title: "Pets", subtitle: "Not Allowed" }, { icon: "👤", title: "Driver Age", subtitle: "Above 21 yrs" }, { icon: "⛽", title: "Fuel Policy", subtitle: "Same to Same" }, { icon: "📏", title: "Kilometer Limit", subtitle: "250 km/day" }, { icon: "⏳", title: "Cancellation", subtitle: "Free till 24 hrs" }, ]; const handleBookNow = () => { setShowBookingNav(true); }; return (
